text: Law is a social science that studies legal phenomena and their laws. It takes the Constitution, departmental laws (civil law, criminal law, administrative law, etc.) and legal practice as its core, and explores the essence, function and application logic of law. This major aims to cultivate professional talents with legal thinking, practical operation skills and a sense of social responsibility, and is committed to maintaining social fairness and justice through the analysis of legal norms, case interpretation and dispute resolution. Law is not only a theoretical discipline (such as legal philosophy and legal history), but also a highly practical applied discipline that needs to solve specific problems in combination with real scenarios such as legislation, judiciary and law enforcement.
